senses.gloss: m. (חָלַט II) final decision, esp. ascertained condition of leprosy after the probationary days of confinement (הֶסְגֵּר, v.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:14">Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>הכא הוא עבד לה׳</he> here (in Miriam’s case) the confinement was ordered for a definite case of leprosy, opp. <he>להסגר</he> for probation; <cite ref="Yoma 2a:8">ib.</cite> <he>ימי ה׳</he> the seven days of Miriam’s leprosy (<cite ref="Numbers 12:14">Num. XII, 14</cite> sq.); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:7">Gen. R. s. 100</cite>.—V. <cite ref="H01041"><he>חֲלִיטָה</he> III</cite>.
